lines: Telo Ride has to feel quick on a phone, and smooth beside the bike. Now a person can measure both.
Home loads cold on a mid-range phone's profile: its processor slowed four times, over slow 4G.
It must paint within two and a half seconds, and answer every touch within two hundred milliseconds.
The race at full HD must hold fifty frames a second, and never drop below thirty for more than a second.
Home, from a phone to the full screen.
They run only on the device being measured, when a person asks.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
